title: Task 019: Start a plain task on a work item
summary: A plain task linked to a work item as a workflow run of kind task: one new route, runner and model changes, the adapter's repository pass-through, and a button with dialog and state in the frontend; no new component and no layer or boundary change.

changes.line: Run model gets optional kind 'task'; the runner starts and follows a plain-task run (no stage move, no session, never done, advance 409); WorkflowTaskStart gets repository.
New POST /workflow-runs/task with its DTO (201/400/404/409) in the runs controller.
EngineWorkflowTasks passes the optional repository through to the engine's start.
startTask(itemId, ...) in the workflow runs API service and the optional kind in the run model.
Workflow runs hook gets startTask; the app opens the task screen after the start.
'▶ Task' in WorkflowControls, NewTaskDialog initial values and heading, a Task run line without steps, wiring in App.

findings.text: The plan builds the kickoff prompt in the frontend without saying where; views only render, behaviour belongs in state or a pure helper.
findings.alternative: Put the prompt builder in a pure function next to the state hook (or workflow-draft style helper) and pass the result to the dialog as initial values.

findings.text: Making a plain task a WorkflowRun of kind task reuses storage, stream and the one-active rule (YAGNI, DRY), but the runner and views then branch on kind and a task run needs a placeholder definition; the plan leaves the representation open.
findings.alternative: Accepted trade-off; keep the branch in one place (runner and one view helper) and make the representation (synthetic definition vs optional fields) a decision before step 1.
